WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
mine AS (
  SELECT business_date, SUM(net_sales) AS web_net_sales, COUNT(*) AS n
  FROM net_lines WHERE store_id = 900 AND business_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-12-15' AND DATE '2025-12-23'
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT d.calendar_date, d.is_trading_day, d.holiday_name, m.web_net_sales, m.n, c.net_sales AS control_net_sales, c.net_sales_before_returns, c.returns_net
FROM dim_date d
LEFT JOIN mine m ON m.business_date = d.calendar_date
LEFT JOIN rpt_daily_store_sales c ON c.business_date = d.calendar_date AND c.store_id = 900
WHERE d.calendar_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-12-15' AND DATE '2025-12-23'
ORDER BY 1

SELECT CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', order_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS order_date_h,
       CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date_h,
       status, fulfilment_type, COUNT(*) AS orders, SUM(order_total_gross) AS gross
FROM fact_web_order
WHERE CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', order_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE '2025-12-17' AND DATE '2025-12-24'
   OR CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE '2025-12-19' AND DATE '2025-12-24'
GROUP BY ALL
ORDER BY 1,2,3,4

WITH w AS (
  SELECT f.*, o.status, o.line_count, o.dispatch_ts_utc,
         CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', o.dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
  LEFT JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
  WHERE s.store_id=900
)
SELECT 'dup_sales_line_id' AS chk, COUNT(*) - COUNT(DISTINCT sales_line_id) AS v FROM w WHERE dispatch_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-12-13' AND DATE '2025-12-28' OR sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-12-13' AND DATE '2025-12-28'
UNION ALL SELECT 'dup_receipt_line', COUNT(*) - COUNT(DISTINCT (receipt_id, line_no)) FROM w WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-12-13' AND DATE '2025-12-28'
UNION ALL SELECT 'lines_no_order', COUNT(*) FROM w WHERE web_order_id_null_dummy IS NULL AND 1=0

WITH w AS (
  SELECT f.sales_line_id, f.receipt_id, f.line_no, f.sale_date, f.net_amount, f.etl_loaded_at, o.web_order_id, o.status, o.line_count,
         CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', o.dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
  LEFT JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
  WHERE s.store_id=900 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-12-10' AND DATE '2025-12-28'
)
SELECT 'rows' AS chk, COUNT(*) AS v FROM w
UNION ALL SELECT 'dup_sales_line_id', COUNT(*) - COUNT(DISTINCT sales_line_id) FROM w
UNION ALL SELECT 'dup_receipt_line', COUNT(*) - COUNT(DISTINCT (receipt_id, line_no)) FROM w
UNION ALL SELECT 'lines_without_order', COUNT(*) FROM w WHERE web_order_id IS NULL
UNION ALL SELECT 'lines_on_cancelled', COUNT(*) FROM w WHERE status='cancelled'
UNION ALL SELECT 'lines_on_processing', COUNT(*) FROM w WHERE status='processing'
UNION ALL SELECT 'distinct_etl_loaded_at', COUNT(DISTINCT etl_loaded_at) FROM w
UNION ALL SELECT 'orders_linecount_mismatch', COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT receipt_id FROM w WHERE web_order_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY receipt_id, line_count HAVING COUNT(*) <> line_count)

SELECT 'sunday_dispatch' AS chk, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', o.dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS d, COUNT(*) AS n, MIN(CAST(NULL AS INTEGER)) AS x
FROM fact_web_order o
WHERE o.status IN ('delivered','collected') AND CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', o.dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) IN (DATE '2025-11-30', DATE '2025-12-07', DATE '2025-12-14', DATE '2025-12-21', DATE '2025-12-28', DATE '2025-12-13', DATE '2025-12-20')
GROUP BY 1,2
UNION ALL
SELECT 'delivered_orders_without_lines', NULL, COUNT(*), NULL FROM fact_web_order o
WHERE o.status IN ('delivered','collected') AND o.dispatch_ts_utc >= TIMESTAMP '2025-12-10' AND o.dispatch_ts_utc < TIMESTAMP '2025-12-30'
  AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fact_sales_line f WHERE f.receipt_id=o.web_order_id)
UNION ALL
SELECT 'etl_load', CAST(etl_loaded_at AS DATE), COUNT(*), NULL FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key WHERE s.store_id=900 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-12-10' AND DATE '2025-12-28' GROUP BY 1,2
ORDER BY 1,2
